name: Dishevelled Chicken
backstory:
__notoc__

Dishevelled Chicken is a beast potentially found in the Goblin Camp in Act One. A plaything for the goblins, the frightened poultry is constantly chased by Devout Mezzka or forced to take part in Krolla's chicken chasing games.
